notes.title: Wholesome Games Celebration & Update demo_1.0.2!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

It's been a while, but here we are again with some exciting news and a small patch for the demo of Calm Cove.

We are excited to announce that we will participate in the Wholesome Games Celebration in August 2024, which will host a bunch of awesome, cozy and cute games! It is very exciting for us to be part of this!

The event will be live from August 15th - August 21th, so be sure to check out as many cozy games as you can. There will be discounts for released games, as well as many demos to try!

Also, we just published a small patch for Calm Cove today (demo_1.0.2):
[list]
[*] We fixed some minor issues with the atmospheric sound loop 
[*] We fixed a bug which didn't let you set the resolution from the options ingame
[/list]

That's it for today, and as always: THANK YOU for playing our game! Hope you enjoyed it so far.

Best wishes from team mellow mind,
Felix

notes.title: Changelog - demo_1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi guys!

A big thank you from our team to all the players of the Calm Cove demo! We hope you had a great time so far.

Today we pushed a little update:
- you can now select the desired resolution manually in options
- Sandbox mode gets unlocked after reaching level 1 in Classic mode, instead of needing to reach level 2

It appeared that the fullscreen option didn't set the screen resolution to its maximum for some players, which caused the game to be rendered in a lower resolution than your monitor supports. 

This is fixed now, because you can manually selected the resolution of your monitor in options. If you want a specific resolution to be added, feel free to reach out to us via the Steam discussions or [url=https://discord.com/invite/4Mz3J2HtCB]our Discord![/url]

Also, the Sandbox mode can now be unlocked on level 1. This reduces the barrier for unlocking it while still keeping the Classic mode as a light tutorial.

If you have any suggestions or feedback - we are listening!

Hope you have a great day and many thanks for playing our game,
Felix

notes.title: A new cozy sandbox game appeared!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Calm Cove![/h1]
Hello there, my name is Felix and I am the developer of Calm Cove, a cozy little island sandbox which rewards you for putting in the effort to detail and build your own miniature island.

Today is a special day as it marks the first milestone of an exciting journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698906/e740fae028b3522bbba3a9fe3a61d097d3f31fe5.gif[/img]

[h1]The Plan[/h1]
With publishing the Steampage an important milestone has been achieved, but that's just the beginning. [b]A LOT[/b] of new content is waiting to be developed to make Calm Cove a game which provides unlimited possibilites of unleashing your creativity. 

The best way to stay updated on the development process of Calm Cove is by checking out the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@_mellowmind]official YouTube channel[/url], where I regularly showcase what's new in the game.

I am working hard on creating an awesome experience for people who want to unwind and relax while playing a video game.

If you think Calm Cove might be a game for you, feel free to put it on your wishlist - any form of support and spreading the word is much appreciated 💙

I hope you share my excitement because the journey of Calm Cove has officially begun!

Best wishes,
Felix
